mutants.description: In S_SS, SS_done is treated as a live 'ceiling at target' flag and cleared on any clock that finds the ceiling below max_on_limit with no step landing, instead of staying latched once the ramp has finished.
mutants.reason: The supervisor stays in S_SS for one more clock after SS_done rises. If the host raises max_on_limit (it can write it at any time) during that clock, the mutant drops SS_done as the supervisor moves to S_RUN. SS_done is then held low for all of S_RUN, where the original holds it high.
